summary: refactor(content-server): move metrics validator and flow-performance
description:
Because:

- FXA-12722 moves code with one consumer out of fxa-shared and into that consumer.

This commit:

- Moves the metric validator and its error class into content-server app/scripts/lib.
- Adds server/lib/flow-performance.js and uses it in flow-event.js.
- Removes flowPerformance from the fxa-shared barrel.
- Ports the validator mocha test to the content-server browser specs.

Closes FXA-14709
